verses.1: These words were spoken by Jesus. Then he raised his eyes to heaven and said, “Father, it is time for me to leave. Let Your Son be glorified, so that He may also glorify You.”
verses.2: Since you have given him the authority over all flesh, so that everything you give him will give them eternal life.
verses.3: This is the eternal life that I have revealed to you: the only true God, and the one whom I sent, Jesus Christ.
verses.4: I have honored you on this earth. Now, after completing your task, you shall give me what I need to carry out my mission.
verses.5: And now, I praise you, Father, for having me share in your glory. Before the world existed, I already had this glory with you.
verses.6: May the name be made known to those people whom you have given me from this world. You yourselves were those people whom you gave me, and their hearts were filled with your words.
verses.7: Now they understood that everything you give me belongs to me.
verses.8: For the words you gave me, I will give them to them. They received them and truly understood that they came from you. They believed that you sent me.
verses.9: I ask about them. I don’t ask about the world itself, but rather about what you will give me. For it is you who are worthy of being given to me.
verses.10: And everything that belongs to me is also belonging to you; I am honored to be among them.
verses.11: And I am no longer in this world. But they are still in this world. I am coming to you. Holy Father, please keep them in the name you have given me, so that they may be one with us.
verses.12: When I was with them, they guarded them under your name, which you would give me. And none of them lost anything, except for the son of perdition. This was so that the law could be fulfilled.
verses.13: Now, I come to you, and I speak these words in this world, so that I may have the joy that I desire fulfilled within myself.
verses.14: I have given them your word. But the world has turned against them, because they are not like me; I am not part of this world.
verses.15: I don’t want you to drive them away from the world. I want you to keep them away from evil.
verses.16: In this world, there is no one like me; I myself am not from this world.
verses.17: Honor them in truth; the truth of the matter is indeed true.
verses.18: Just as you sent me into the world, so I also sent them into the world.
verses.19: And for them, I also sanctify myself, so that they too may be truly sanctified.
verses.20: I don’t ask about these things alone; I also ask about those who believe in God through their words.
verses.21: So that they all become one. Just as you, Father, are in me, and I am in you; so too, they should be in us. Then the world will believe that you sent me.
verses.22: I will give you the glory that you give me, so that they may be one, just as we are one.
verses.23: I am among them, and you are among me. This way, they can be completely united with each other. Then, the world will know that you have sent me and loved them just as I loved you.
verses.24: Father, whatever you have given me, I want to be where I am with you. I want them to see the glory that you have given me, because you loved me before the world was created.
verses.25: Father, you are righteous. The world does not know you. But I do know you. And they also know that I sent you to me.
verses.26: And I will tell them your name, so that the love you have for me can also be present among them.
